body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). `packages/merge-forecast/test/forecast.test.mjs` and `packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs` define hand-rolled `mkTemp`, `cleanup`, and git repo initialization helpers with manual `try/finally` blocks and are allowlisted in `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`. With `@adlc/core/test-kit` (`tmp`, `gitRepo`), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via `t.after` when passed the test context `t`.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/merge-forecast/test/forecast.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace manual `mkdtempSync` and git init/config with `tmp(t)` / `gitRepo(t)`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { rmSync(dir, ...); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
2. In `packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs`:
   - Import `{ tmp, gitRepo }` from `@adlc/core/test-kit`.
   - Update test declarations to accept `t` parameter.
   - Replace `mkTemp()` with `tmp(t, 'mf-hrc-test-')`.
   - Remove all `try { ... } finally { cleanup(dir); }` blocks, unindenting the test bodies.
   - Delete local `mkTemp` and `cleanup` helpers.
3. In `scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`:
   - Remove `'packages/merge-forecast/test/forecast.test.mjs'` and `'packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs'` from the `ALLOWLIST` set.
4. Verification:
   - `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast` exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
   - `grep -c 'finally' packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs` is 0.
   - `grep -c 'cleanup' packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs` is 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `grep -c 'finally' packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs` is 0.
- AC2 `grep -c 'cleanup' packages/merge-forecast/test/high-risk-concurrent.test.mjs` is 0.
- AC3 `grep -E 'packages/merge-forecast/test/' scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/merge-forecast` exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 `node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs` exits 0.
- AC6 `adlc rails-guard` exits 0.
title: refactor(merge-forecast): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit and eliminate 32 try/finally blocks in forecast and high-risk-concurrent tests
